newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Keegan Q4 business matching year-ago.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Keegan Q4 business matching year-ago.

text.p: Morgan Keegan Inc said Tuesday its business in the current fiscal fourth quarter appeared to be on a par with the year-earlier period but was slower than the record pace of last winter.
Morgan Keegan reported earnings for the third quarter ended April 30 of $6.9 million, or $0.33 per share, down 19 percent from the year-earlier $8.6 million, or $0.41 per share.
Morgan Keegan Chairman Allen Morgan Jr attributed the lower results to a stock market correction in March and April.
"Commissions in the last two months of the quarter were down more than 12 percent," he said.
Morgan Keegan is a Memphis-based holding company providing securities brokerage, investment banking and other financial services.
